title: UpdateEnvironmentInput
description: The fields that can be specified when updating an environment.

title.description: A human readable title for this environment.

description.description: A human readable description of this environment.

matching.description:
This field indicates how environments can be considered for selection
when Posit Connect is choosing a compatible environment to use when
executing content.

`any` (the default) indicates that the image can be selected by Connect
automatically,
_or_ targeted in the bundle's manifest.

`exact` indicates the image must be explicitly asked for in the bundle's
manifest.

`none` indicates that the image should never be selected by Posit Connect.

supervisor.description:
The path to the script or command that should be used as the
[program
supervisor](https://docs.posit.co/helm/rstudio-connect/kubernetes-howto/appendices/content_images.html#per-image-supervisors)
when executing content with this environment.

python.description: The available Python installations in this environment.

nodejs.description: The available Node.js installations in this environment.

quarto.description: The available Quarto installations in this environment.

r.description: The available R installations in this environment.

tensorflow.description: The available TensorFlow installations in this environment.

volume_mounts.description: The volume mounts for this environment.

Installation.description: An instance of an interpreter within an execution environment.

version.description: The semantic version of the interpreter.

path.description: The absolute path to the interpreter's executable.

Installations.description: A list of language installations available to an environment.

VolumeMount.description: A volume mount configuration for an environment.

source.description: The source specification for this mount.

target.description: The target specification for this mount.

VolumeSource.description: The source specification for a volume mount.

nfs_host.description: The NFS host. Required when `volume_type` is `nfs`.

nfs_export_path.description: The NFS export path. Required when `volume_type` is `nfs`.

pvc_name.description: The PersistentVolumeClaim name. Required when `volume_type` is `pvc`.

VolumeTarget.description: The target specification for a volume mount.

path.description: The mount path inside the container.

read_only.description: Whether the volume is mounted read-only.
